record.question: US President Donald Trump has announced tariffs on all goods importing from ________.
record.explanation: Answer B: Mexico. In May 2019 Donald Trump announced proposed tariffs on all Mexican imports; the announcement was later suspended after a U.S.–Mexico agreement. The date-specific announcement makes Mexico the answer. Reference: https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/briefings-statements/statement-president-regarding-emergency-measures-address-border-crisis/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
